parameters.name: Affinity
parameters.description: Specifies whether to associate the instance with the dedicated host. Valid values:

parameters.name: Cpu
parameters.description: The number of vCPUs.

parameters.name: CreditSpecification
parameters.description: The running mode of the burstable instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: CustomPriorities
parameters.description: The custom priorities of **ECS instance type + vSwitch** combinations.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceType
sub_parameters.description: The CustomPriorities field specifies the custom priorities of **ECS instance type + vSwitch** combinations. The CustomPriorities.N.InstanceType parameter specifies the ECS instance type in the custom priority.

sub_parameters.name: VswitchId
sub_parameters.description: The CustomPriorities.N.VswitchId parameter specifies the ID of the vSwitch in the custom priority.

parameters.name: DataDisk
parameters.description: The list of data disks.

sub_parameters.name: AutoSnapshotPolicyId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy applied to data disk N. Valid values of N: 1 to 16.

sub_parameters.name: BurstingEnabled
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the burst feature for the data disk. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: Categories
sub_parameters.description: The multiple disk types of data disk N. The first N indicates data disk N. Valid values: 1 to 16. The second N indicates the Nth disk type for data disk N. Valid values: 1 to 4. This means that you can specify up to 4 disk types for a data disk in a scaling configuration. A smaller value of N indicates a higher priority. When a disk type with a higher priority cannot be used, Auto Scaling automatically attempts the disk type with the next priority to create the data disk. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: Category
sub_parameters.description: The category of data disk N. Valid values of N: 1 to 16. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: DeleteWithInstance
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether data disk N is released with the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 16. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: Description
sub_parameters.description: The description of data disk N. Valid values of N: 1 to 16. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Device
sub_parameters.description: The mount point of data disk N. Valid values of N: 1 to 16. If you do not specify this parameter, the default behavior during automatic creation of ECS instances is that the system allocates a mount point, starting from /dev/xvdb to /dev/xvdz.

sub_parameters.name: DiskName
sub_parameters.description: The name of data disk N. Valid values of N: 1 to 16. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-).

sub_parameters.name: Encrypted
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether data disk N is encrypted. Valid values of N: 1 to 16. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: KMSKeyId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the KMS key for data disk N. Valid values of N: 1 to 16.

sub_parameters.name: PerformanceLevel
sub_parameters.description: The performance level (PL) of the data cloud disk when the data disk is an ESSD cloud disk. You cannot set this parameter when the data disk is a standard SSD. The value of N must be consistent with the N in DataDisk.N.Category=cloud_essd. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: ProvisionedIops
sub_parameters.description: The provisioned IOPS (Input/Output Operations Per Second) performance metrics of the data disk.

sub_parameters.name: Size
sub_parameters.description: The size of data disk N. Valid values of N: 1 to 16. Unit: GiB. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: SnapshotId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the snapshot used to create data disk N. Valid values of N: 1 to 16. If you specify this parameter, DataDisk.N.Size is ignored. The actual size of the created disk is the size of the specified snapshot.

parameters.name: DedicatedHostClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the dedicated host cluster.

parameters.name: DedicatedHostId
parameters.description: Specifies whether to create the ECS instance on a dedicated host. Because dedicated hosts do not support the creation of spot instances, if you specify DedicatedHostId, the SpotStrategy and SpotPriceLimit settings in the request are automatically ignored.

parameters.name: DeletionProtection
parameters.description: The release protection property of the ECS instance. This parameter applies only to pay-as-you-go instances and specifies whether the instance can be directly released from the ECS console or by calling the DeleteInstance operation. Valid values:

parameters.name: DeploymentSetId
parameters.description: The ID of the deployment set to which the ECS instance belongs.

parameters.name: HostName
parameters.description: The hostname of the Elastic Computing Service server. A period (.) or a hyphen (-) cannot be used as the first or last character, or used consecutively. In addition, the naming conventions for different types of instances are as follows:

parameters.name: HpcClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the HPC cluster to which the ECS instance belongs.

parameters.name: HttpEndpoint
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the access channel for instance metadata. Valid values:

parameters.name: HttpTokens
parameters.description: Specifies whether to forcefully use the hardened mode (IMDSv2) when accessing instance metadata. Valid values:

parameters.name: ImageFamily
parameters.description: The name of the image family. You can set this parameter to obtain the latest available image from the specified image family for instance creation. If you set `ImageId`, you cannot set this parameter.

parameters.name: ImageId
parameters.description: The ID of the image file used for automatic creation of instances.

parameters.name: ImageName
parameters.description: The name of the image file. Image names must be unique within a region. If you set ImageId, ImageName is ignored.

parameters.name: ImageOptions.LoginAsNonRoot
parameters.description: Specifies whether the ECS instance uses the ecs-user user to log on. For more information, see [Manage the logon name of an ECS instance](~~388447~~). Valid values:

parameters.name: InstanceDescription
parameters.description: The description of the ECS instance. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the ECS instance that is created through automatic creation by using the scaling configuration.

parameters.name: InstancePatternInfo
parameters.description: The instance type-related information in intelligent mode.

sub_parameters.name: Architecture
sub_parameters.description: The architecture type of the instance type. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: BurstablePerformance
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether to include burstable instance types. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: Cores
sub_parameters.description: The number of vCPU cores of the instance type in intelligent configuration mode. This parameter is used to filter instance types that meet the requirements. For more information, see [Instance families](~~25378~~). Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

sub_parameters.name: CpuArchitectures
sub_parameters.description: The CPU architectures of the instance.

sub_parameters.name: ExcludedInstanceType
sub_parameters.description: The instance types to exclude. You can use wildcard characters (*) to exclude a single instance type or an entire instance family. Examples:

sub_parameters.name: GpuSpecs
sub_parameters.description: The specified GPU types.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceCategories
sub_parameters.description: The instance type categories. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: InstanceFamilyLevel
sub_parameters.description: The level of the instance family in intelligent configuration mode. This parameter is used to filter instance types that meet the requirements. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: InstanceTypeFamilies
sub_parameters.description: The specified instance families.

sub_parameters.name: MaxPrice
sub_parameters.description: The maximum hourly price for pay-as-you-go instances or spot instances in intelligent configuration mode. This parameter is used to filter instance types that meet the requirements. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

sub_parameters.name: MaximumCpuCoreCount
sub_parameters.description: The maximum number of vCPU cores of the instance type.

sub_parameters.name: MaximumGpuAmount
sub_parameters.description: The expected maximum number of GPUs of the instance. Valid values: positive integers ≥ 1.

sub_parameters.name: MaximumMemorySize
sub_parameters.description: The expected maximum memory size of the instance. Unit: GiB.

sub_parameters.name: Memory
sub_parameters.description: The memory size of the instance type in intelligent configuration mode. Unit: GiB. This parameter is used to filter instance types that meet the requirements. For more information, see [Instance families](~~25378~~). Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

sub_parameters.name: MinimumBaselineCredit
sub_parameters.description: The expected minimum baseline vCPU computing performance (sum of all vCPUs) for burstable instances (t5 and t6).

sub_parameters.name: MinimumCpuCoreCount
sub_parameters.description: The minimum number of vCPU cores of the instance type.

sub_parameters.name: MinimumEniIpv6AddressQuantity
sub_parameters.description: The expected minimum number of IPv6 addresses per elastic network interfaces (ENIs) network interface controller (NIC) of the instance.

sub_parameters.name: MinimumEniPrivateIpAddressQuantity
sub_parameters.description: The expected minimum number of IPv4 addresses per elastic network interfaces (ENIs) network interface controller (NIC) of the instance.

sub_parameters.name: MinimumEniQuantity
sub_parameters.description: The expected minimum number of elastic network interfaces (ENIs) supported by the instance.

sub_parameters.name: MinimumGpuAmount
sub_parameters.description: The expected minimum number of GPUs of the instance. Valid values: positive integers ≥ 1.

sub_parameters.name: MinimumInitialCredit
sub_parameters.description: The expected minimum initial vCPU credits for burstable instances (t5 and t6).

sub_parameters.name: MinimumMemorySize
sub_parameters.description: The expected minimum memory size of the instance. Unit: GiB.

sub_parameters.name: PhysicalProcessorModels
sub_parameters.description: The processor models of the instance.

parameters.name: InstanceTypeOverride
parameters.description: The instance type-related information.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceType
sub_parameters.description: To specify the capacity of an instance type in the scaling configuration, specify both this parameter and InstanceTypeOverride.N.WeightedCapacity.

sub_parameters.name: WeightedCapacity
sub_parameters.description: To specify the capacity of an instance type in the scaling configuration, specify this parameter after you specify InstanceTypeOverride.N.InstanceType. The two parameters must correspond to each other, and the values of N must be consistent.

parameters.name: InstanceTypes
parameters.description: The multiple instance type parameter. If you specify InstanceTypes.N, InstanceType is ignored. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. This means that you can specify up to 20 instance types in a scaling configuration.

parameters.name: InternetChargeType
parameters.description: The billing method for network usage. Valid values:

parameters.name: InternetMaxBandwidthIn
parameters.description: The maximum inbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values:

parameters.name: InternetMaxBandwidthOut
parameters.description: The maximum outbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: 0 to 100.

parameters.name: IoOptimized
parameters.description: Specifies whether the instance is an I/O optimization instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: Ipv6AddressCount
parameters.description: The number of randomly generated IPv6 addresses allocated to the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). You can also refer to this as the number of IPv6 addresses assigned to the network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: KeyPairName
parameters.description: The name of the key pair used to log on to the ECS instance.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerWeight
parameters.description: The weight of SLB backend server. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: Memory
parameters.description: The memory size.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaces
parameters.description: The list of elastic network interfaces (ENIs).

sub_parameters.name: InstanceType
sub_parameters.description: The type of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) network interface controller (NIC). When you use this parameter, you must use NetworkInterfaces.N to Settings the primary network interface controller (NIC), but you cannot specify SecurityGroupId or SecurityGroupIds.N at the same time. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: Ipv6AddressCount
sub_parameters.description: The number of randomly generated IPv6 addresses for the primary ENI. Note the following items:

sub_parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceTrafficMode
sub_parameters.description: The communication mode of the ENI. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: SecondaryPrivateIpAddressCount
sub_parameters.description: The number of secondary private IPv4 addresses assigned to the ENI. Valid values: 1 to 49.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityGroupIds
sub_parameters.description: The IDs of one or more security groups to which the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) network interface controller (NIC) belongs.

sub_parameters.name: VSwitchIds
sub_parameters.description: The IDs of the vSwitches to which the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) network interface controller (NIC) belongs. N indicates that you can Settings multiple vSwitches. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: Override
parameters.description: Specifies whether to override existing data. Valid values:

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password of the ECS instance. The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The following special characters are supported:

parameters.name: PasswordInherit
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use the password preset in the image. To use this parameter, make sure that a password is configured for the image.

parameters.name: PrivatePoolOptions.Id
parameters.description: The ID of the private pool. The ID of an Elasticity Assurance or Capacity Reservation.

parameters.name: PrivatePoolOptions.MatchCriteria
parameters.description: The private pool option for instance startup. After an Elasticity Assurance or Capacity Reservation takes effect, a private pool is generated. You can select a private pool when you start an instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: RamRoleName
parameters.description: The name of the RAM role associated with the ECS instance. The name is provided and maintained by RAM. You can call [ListRoles](~~28713~~) to query available RAM roles. For more information about how to create a RAM role, see [CreateRole](~~28710~~).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the ECS instance belongs.

parameters.name: ResourcePoolOptions
parameters.description: The resource pool policy used when creating instances. After you set this parameter, note the following items:

parameters.name: ScalingConfigurationId
parameters.description: The ID of the scaling configuration that you want to modify.

parameters.name: ScalingConfigurationName
parameters.description: The name of the scaling configuration. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). It must start with a letter, digit, or Chinese character.

parameters.name: SchedulerOptions
parameters.description: The scheduler options.

parameters.name: SecondaryEniVSwitchConstraint
parameters.description: Specifies whether a vSwitch must be selected from the VSwitchIds list that is active for the secondary elastic network interfaces (ENIs) network interface controller (NIC) when the VSwitchIds parameter is Settings for the secondary elastic network interfaces (ENIs) network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group to which the ECS instance belongs. ECS instances in the same security group can access each other.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the security groups to which the ECS instance is added. The valid values of N depend on the maximum number of security groups to which an instance can belong. For more information, see the security group section in [Limits](~~25412~~).

parameters.name: SecurityOptions
parameters.description: The security options.

parameters.name: SpotDuration
parameters.description: The retention period of the spot instance. Unit: hours. Valid values:

parameters.name: SpotInterruptionBehavior
parameters.description: The interruption pattern of the spot instance. Only Terminate (default) is supported, which directly releases the instance.

parameters.name: SpotPriceLimit
parameters.description: The collection of spot instance information.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceType
sub_parameters.description: The instance type of the spot instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. This parameter takes effect only when SpotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit.

sub_parameters.name: PriceLimit
sub_parameters.description: The price limit of the spot instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. This parameter takes effect only when SpotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit.

parameters.name: SpotStrategy
parameters.description: The preemption policy for pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values:

parameters.name: StorageSetId
parameters.description: The ID of the storage set.

parameters.name: StorageSetPartitionNumber
parameters.description: The maximum number of partitions in the storage set. Valid values: greater than or equal to 2.

parameters.name: SystemDisk.AutoSnapshotPolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy applied to the system disk.

parameters.name: SystemDisk.BurstingEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the burst (performance burst) feature for the system cloud disk. Valid values:

parameters.name: SystemDisk.Category
parameters.description: The category of the system disk. Valid values:

parameters.name: SystemDisk.Description
parameters.description: The description of the system disk. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: SystemDisk.DiskName
parameters.description: The name of the system disk. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-).

parameters.name: SystemDisk.EncryptAlgorithm
parameters.description: The encryption algorithm used by the system cloud disk. Valid values:

parameters.name: SystemDisk.Encrypted
parameters.description: Specifies whether to encrypt the system cloud disk. Valid values:

parameters.name: SystemDisk.KMSKeyId
parameters.description: The ID of the KMS key used by the system cloud disk.

parameters.name: SystemDisk.PerformanceLevel
parameters.description: The performance level (PL) of the system cloud disk when the system disk is an ESSD cloud disk. You cannot set this parameter when the system disk is a standard SSD. Valid values:

parameters.name: SystemDisk.ProvisionedIops
parameters.description: The provisioned IOPS (Input/Output Operations Per Second) performance metrics of the system cloud disk.

parameters.name: SystemDisk.Size
parameters.description: The size of the system disk. Unit: GiB. Valid values:

parameters.name: SystemDiskCategories
parameters.description: The disk types of the system cloud disk. Valid values of N: 1 to 4, which means you can specify up to four disk types for the system cloud disk in a scaling configuration. A smaller value of N indicates a higher priority. When a disk type with a higher priority is unavailable, Auto Scaling automatically attempts the next-priority disk type to create the system cloud disk. Valid values:

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tags of the ECS instance. Tags are specified as key-value pairs. You can specify up to 20 tags. The following limits apply to the Key and Value parameters:

parameters.name: Tenancy
parameters.description: Specifies whether to create the instance on a dedicated host. Valid values:

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: The user data of the ECS instance. The data must be encoded in Base64. The maximum size of the raw data before encoding is 32 KB.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID of the ECS instance.
